questions.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the main reasons a journal batch might fail to post?
options: The journal is unbalanced and suspense posting isn't allowed in the ledger
The accounting period is closed
A line references an invalid or disabled account combination
The supplier's bank account is missing
questions.explain: A missing supplier bank account is a Payables payment issue (see Lesson 9), not a reason a GL journal would fail to post.

questions.q: What does 'suspense posting' allow a ledger to do with an unbalanced journal?
options: Reject the journal outright with no option to post
Post the difference between debits and credits to a suspense account instead of blocking the entry
Automatically delete the unbalanced line
Convert the journal to a different currency
questions.explain: If a ledger allows suspense posting, an unbalanced journal's difference is posted to a suspense account rather than being rejected.

questions.q: In the Meridian Steel ticket, what was the actual root cause of the 40-journal batch failing to post?
options: All 40 journals were unbalanced
The accounting period was closed
One journal line referenced an account combination that had been disabled during a recent chart-of-accounts cleanup
The batch had not been approved yet
questions.explain: A single line in one journal referenced a disabled account, and that one invalid line blocked the posting attempt for the entire 40-journal batch.

questions.q: How was it confirmed that only one journal, not the whole batch, was actually the problem?
options: By testing whether the other 39 journals could post independently of the one with the disabled account
By re-entering the whole batch from scratch
By asking the GL accountant to guess
By closing and reopening the period
questions.explain: Testing the other 39 journals independently confirmed they posted cleanly, isolating the problem to the single journal referencing the disabled account.

questions.q: What was the recommended process improvement in the resolution note?
options: Stop performing chart-of-accounts cleanups entirely
Enable suspense posting for every ledger
Require all journals to be entered manually going forward
Have the chart-of-accounts cleanup project circulate disabled account values to GL accountants before disabling them
questions.explain: The note recommends proactively notifying GL accountants of accounts being disabled, to catch any transactions still coded to them before they cause a posting failure.
